fields.options: The chassis numbering rule A3 stamps on every trailer. Redlines confirms the format, prefix, check digit and starting number; nothing is assumed here.

fields.description: Tick only once Redlines has confirmed the format below. Chassis numbers are not issued until this is ticked, so an unconfirmed rule can never be embossed onto a trailer.
fields.label: Format Confirmed by Redlines

fields.description: Leading text, e.g. A3. Left blank the number is digits only.
fields.label: Prefix

fields.description: Placed between the parts. Leave blank to run them together.
fields.label: Separator

fields.description: Digits in the running number, zero padded.
fields.label: Sequence Length

fields.description: The number the next chassis will take. Set this to the starting number Redlines specifies.
fields.label: Next Number

fields.description: Appended as a final digit, computed over the digits of the number.
fields.label: Check Digit

fields.description: What the next chassis number will look like under the settings above.
fields.label: Next Chassis Number
